verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents its remote-access path: clients connect peer-to-peer when they can and fall back to a relay. You can use the vendor's rendezvous/relay server or self-host your own with a documented Docker compose step. Users confirm reaching machines with their own relay without opening ports or using a VPN, and a Docker self-host worked. Other hands-on reports describe laggy or near-impossible connections even when self-hosted, and difficulty self-hosting, which lowers quality and confidence. Missing for 10: documented port-forward/firewall and direct-IP requirements in the evidence, and consistent independent reliability corroboration.
